structured_output.what_is_happening: On 2026-09-25, Yuga Labs' 0xQuit carried out a real, widely reported white-hat rescue. He moved thousands of NFTs (reports say 3,832 to over 23,000) out of wallets exposed to a suspected Magic Eden Ethereum flaw. Memecoin deployers immediately launched a swarm of "The White Hat / 0xquit" tokens on Solana (pump.fun, PumpSwap, Meteora) and on Base/ETH (Uniswap). DexScreener shows about 30 same-ticker pairs. This token (3ejo…) launched on a Meteora virtual curve (DBC), graduated right away, and trades on a PumpSwap pool with $35k of liquidity and 0% of its LP locked. The canonical pump.fun token, J141…pump, launched earlier and is larger (about $336k market cap). This one is a copy.

narrative.description: A real crypto-native news event: 0xQuit (Yuga Labs VP of blockchain) did a white-hat rescue of NFTs during a suspected Magic Eden flaw, covered by Cointelegraph, CryptoTimes and others on 2026-09-25.
narrative.why_spreading: It is fresh crypto-Twitter news about a named, liked figure, which is easy meme material. But the attention is split across dozens of copy tokens on several chains, and interest in the underlying news story will probably decay within hours.

token_connection.why_this_token: Same name and ticker only. It was not first: J141 (pump.fun) and 69GST came before it, and J141 is the one carrying a Twitter link and the largest market cap on Solana. The packet's links point to an unrelated account's X post (DevWizardxbt) and to 0xQuit's own post, not to any official project.
token_connection.competing_tokens: J141JCiX…pump ($336k, the pump.fun leader), 9fGR… ($280k, $2.1M volume in 1h), xx4g… ($3.3M volume in 1h), 5cSv/C8ns/ERRP (liquidity already at $0), plus about 10 Uniswap copies on Base/ETH.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN flags 87 bundler wallets, and RugCheck shows a 78-wallet insider trade network. There were 2,148 unique buyers but only 143 unique sellers over the hour: a lopsided count that suggests bot or volume-farm buying. Volume of $700k in 1h on $34k of liquidity. The image is duplicated 9 times. No project site, socials or DexScreener profile, and a search for the contract address returned no mentions.
authenticity.uncertainty: There is no X data. Some buyers may be real traders spreading across the copies.
